# Audio Lounge

> Audio Lounge is a music player for people who own and care about their music. Audio Lounge 1.1.1 is available for Mac, and the newly launched Audio Lounge Air 1.1.1 is available for iPad.

## Official pages

- [Audio Lounge](https://audiolounge.app/): Product overview and current release.
- [Download](https://audiolounge.app/download/): Official App Store links for Mac and iPad.
- [HALO Network Audio](https://audiolounge.app/halo/): Product details and the official HALO Endpoint setup guide.
- [SMB Direct](https://audiolounge.app/smb/): Official SMB Direct setup guide.
- [FAQ](https://audiolounge.app/faq/): Supported formats, playback behavior, HALO, and SMB Direct.
- [Help](https://audiolounge.app/help/): Support information.
- [Blog](https://audiolounge.app/blog/): Product essays and release background.

## Technical guides

- [How to play SACD ISO on Mac and iPad](https://audiolounge.app/guides/play-sacd-iso-mac-ipad/): Direct SACD ISO playback with Audio Lounge, including DST decoding, Native DSD, NAS and iPad workflows.
- [How to play DSD on Mac with a USB DAC](https://audiolounge.app/guides/play-dsd-on-mac/): DSD rates, DSF and DFF, Native DSD, DoP, DAC compatibility, and HALO.
- [How to play music from a NAS on Mac and iPad](https://audiolounge.app/guides/play-music-from-nas-mac-ipad/): SMB, SMB Direct, library formats, USB DAC output, and HALO.

## Product facts

- Audio Lounge organizes and plays a listener's own music library on Mac.
- Audio Lounge Air brings the full Audio Lounge experience to iPadOS and is available from https://apps.apple.com/us/app/audio-lounge-air/id6797962758.
- Supported formats include FLAC, ALAC, WAV, AIFF, APE, WavPack, AAC, MP3, CUE, DSF, DFF, and SACD ISO.
- Audio Lounge reads SACD ISO directly and decompresses DST-compressed SACD audio on Mac and iPad; extraction to DSF is not required.
- Audio Lounge supports gapless playback, automatic sample-rate matching, optional PCM upsampling, and Native DSD or DoP output with compatible USB DACs.
- SMB Direct connects Audio Lounge directly to a NAS or SMB share.
- HALO is Audio Lounge's high-resolution local-network audio path to a lightweight Linux endpoint beside a USB DAC.
- HALO supports bit-perfect PCM, DoP, optional PCM upsampling, and Native DSD up to DSD512 with compatible endpoint hardware and DACs.
- When supported by the endpoint and DAC, HALO can preserve the Native DSD playback path without converting it to PCM.
- The HALO Endpoint or USB DAC is selected directly inside Audio Lounge.
- HALO Endpoint supports Linux ARM64 and x86_64, including DietPi, Raspberry Pi OS 64-bit, and Ubuntu.
- HALO Endpoint uses a binary-only installer; users do not clone the source repository or compile the daemon.
- Music stays on the listener's Mac, external drive, or network storage; Audio Lounge does not require a cloud upload or account.

## Installation

The canonical HALO setup guide is https://audiolounge.app/halo/.

The official installer command is:

```sh
curl -fsSL https://audiolounge.app/halo/install.sh | sudo bash
```
